description: Ensemble arranger: describe one passage; the LLM composes 2-6 voices TOGETHER (one schema-forced call) with a register + complexity hierarchy — top voice highest and most florid, bottom voice a sparse root anchor — then a mechanical validator enforces registers, density caps, per-voice monophony, and style rules (counterpoint / chorale / interlock). Each voice lands on its own Surge XT track as one voice-group.
